source.prompt: Bare-item spec (owner direction 2026-08-09, third respec of the ①b(a) spike): held items are generated WITHOUT any hand and REST ON the body sheet's drawn hand, MapleStory-style — the earlier baked-in gripping hand was rejected as too realistic for the chibi style and not generic (every item would need its own hand, matched per skin tone). The item's `grip` is the point that lands on the body's hand anchor: for resting items the bottom-center (slight overlap so the drawn mitten peeks out under the item = the held reading); for long shafted items the measured shaft point where the hand carries it. Items pair with the carry pose sheets (both arms still — the swing walk leaves every anchor reading as floating, measured). Generated via Cloudflare AI Gateway (kaede-assets) with google/nano-banana-2 (~$0.10), image_input = the base stand frame as style reference. Generation prompt: a simple white ceramic mug of coffee. A plain cylinder with NO handle visible (handle faces away, hidden; an earlier take's handle ring let body parts behind show through the hole). Upright, brown coffee seen from a slight top-down angle, tiny steam wisp. Only the mug, no hand, flat pure green background. grip lowered from [0.5, 0.95] to [0.5, 0.75] after owner review: flat-bottomed resting items (mug, notebook) read as floating when their bottom merely touches the mitten top — sinking the bottom ~4px into the mitten (the hand layer redraws the mitten in front) reads as held in the hand. Round-bottomed or shafted items (plush, umbrella, spear) keep their grips.
